stories.title: Pakistani Leaders Hold Historic Video Call With Astronaut in Space
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir conducted a live video call with Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, Pakistan's first astronaut, who is currently aboard China’s Tiangong space station. The conversation took place from the headquarters of the Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (Suparco), with the prime minister hailing the milestone as a source of immense national pride for Pakistan's 240 million citizens.

During the call, Field Marshal Munir praised the achievement, noting that the armed forces and the entire nation share in the historic milestone. He also emphasized the strong bilateral relations between Pakistan and China, describing their partnership as reaching the vastness of the universe. The mission began when the Shenzhou-24 spacecraft launched from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre in China's Gobi Desert aboard a Long March-2F rocket, successfully docking with the Tiangong space station after a three-and-a-half-hour flight.

Zeeshan Ali serves as a payload specialist on a three-member crew that includes Chinese astronauts Tang Hongbo, the mission commander, and flight engineer Wu Yi. His arrival at the station marks the first time a foreign astronaut has visited Tiangong and places Pakistan among nations participating in human spaceflight, creating new opportunities for scientific cooperation with Beijing.

The historic flight underscores expanding space collaboration and highlights technical training efforts facilitated by Chinese and Pakistani space agencies. The event is significant for fostering bilateral ties during a period of joint scientific projects, with officials emphasizing the broader geopolitical and technological advancements represented by the mission.

stories.title: Death Toll Rises to 13 Following Karachi Building Collapse
stories.summary:
Rescue personnel in Karachi recovered four additional bodies from the ruins of a collapsed six-storey structure near the Baloch Colony district, bringing the confirmed death toll to 13. The under-construction site, which was reportedly built illegally on a residential property, initially caved in on Wednesday, leaving three individuals dead and 14 others wounded. Search operations intensified as teams utilized heavy equipment and manual tools to clear the debris and locate remaining missing victims.

Authorities have taken administrative actions in response to the disaster. Sindh Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah ordered the dismissal of Sindh Local Government Secretary Waseem Shamshad, East Deputy Commissioner Nasrullah Abbasi, and SSP East Zubair Sheikh due to official negligence. Additionally, 16 officials from the Sindh Building Control Authority faced suspension, and police were instructed to detain the owner, Salman Tahir, and builder, Zeeshan. Investigators have also gathered construction materials from the site to assess safety standard compliance.

The tragedy follows a recent crackdown on unauthorized real estate developments across Karachi. According to a report submitted to the chief minister, authorities have sealed 516 buildings in an ongoing citywide operation. Senior officials, including Karachi Commissioner Syed Hassan Naqvi, urged continued enforcement against illegal constructions. Meanwhile, rescue teams continue to comb through the wreckage, supported by provincial officials and emergency personnel overseeing the recovery efforts.

stories.title: Maritime Agency Reports Ship Hijacking Off Southern Yemen Coast
stories.summary:
Unidentified armed individuals have seized control of a cargo vessel in waters off the southern coast of Yemen, according to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency. The incident occurred approximately 120 kilometers southwest of Balhaf, leaving the unauthorized personnel in full command of the ship. Maritime authorities have been formally notified and are currently investigating the situation.

In response to the incident, the maritime agency issued a safety advisory urging passing vessels to navigate the region with extreme caution and report any suspicious activities immediately. This event follows a noted increase in maritime piracy incidents surrounding the nearby Horn of Africa over the past year. Furthermore, commercial vessels in the Arabian Peninsula have frequently encountered regional security threats amidst ongoing conflicts in the Middle East.

stories.title: President Zardari and Interior Minister Naqvi Discuss Political Strategy
stories.summary:
Pakistan President Asif Ali Zardari traveled to Lahore to meet with Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi at his residence. The high-level discussion included the participation of Punjab Assembly Speaker and Pakistan Muslim League-Nawaz leader Malik Muhammad Ahmad Khan. The leaders conferred on the prevailing political climate within the country.

Talks during the gathering centered on relations with Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam Fazlur Rehman and its leader, Maulana Fazlur Rehman. Attendees also reviewed broader governance matters concerning the provinces. The meeting took place shortly after President Zardari held prior consultations with PML-Q President Chaudhry Shujaat Hussain.

stories.title: Bilawal Urges Politicians to Prioritize Public Welfare Over Revenge
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari stated that politicians must address severe economic challenges rather than engaging in political vendettas against opponents. Speaking at a ceremony in Rahim Yar Khan for a new Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation facility, he described the current economic crisis as unprecedented and warned that conditions could worsen without unity. He emphasized that leaders should focus on inflation, unemployment, and poverty relief.

Bilawal called on political parties to respect each other's mandates and uphold democratic traditions established by past leaders like Benazir Bhutto and Nawaz Sharif. He highlighted the importance of protecting public welfare projects from shifting political rivalries. The newly initiated hospital project in Rahim Yar Khan will feature 50 beds in its first phase, offering free dialysis, laboratory tests, and emergency medical services to local residents.

The project's advancement was supported by Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif, whom Bilawal thanked for avoiding political obstacles in South Punjab. He also acknowledged local party officials and the Sindh government for securing land and resources. Bilawal stressed that public services, particularly healthcare for underprivileged communities, must remain a primary objective for the nation's political leadership.

stories.title: Sindh Chief Minister Invites Bohra Community to Expand Investments
stories.summary:
Sindh Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah has called upon the Dawoodi Bohra business community to increase investments in Sindh, establish new industrial ventures, and partner with local entrepreneurs. Speaking at the Dawoodi Bohra Business Summit, titled Exploring Opportunities, held at An Nadi al Burhani, the chief minister praised the community's long-standing contributions to trade, commerce, manufacturing, and philanthropy in Karachi and across the province.

Highlighting Sindh's strategic economic position, the chief minister pointed out that Karachi serves as Pakistan's commercial and financial hub, complete with major ports, extensive industrial infrastructure, a large consumer market, and rich agricultural and mineral resources. He identified key sectors with high investment potential, including manufacturing, textiles, food processing, pharmaceuticals, engineering, logistics, information technology, construction materials, and renewable energy, while also drawing attention to Special Economic Zones such as Dhabeji, Khairpur, and Bin Qasim.

To foster a favorable business climate, the chief minister assured participants that his administration is actively improving the business environment through investment facilitation, infrastructure development, and Single Window arrangements. He emphasized that the government is committed to offering practical support throughout the entire business process, from identifying opportunities and securing approvals to establishing operations, while strengthening coordination between government departments and the business sector.

During the event, Special Assistant to the Chief Minister Syed Qassim Naveed Qamar briefed attendees on Sindh's diversified project portfolio worth approximately $5.2 billion. This portfolio includes $600 million in completed projects, $650 million under construction, $370 million seeking investors, and roughly $2 billion at the feasibility stage. The summit also featured presentations by ten young entrepreneurs who showcased their innovative business ideas stemming from the department's Tijarathon and Kidpreneurs initiatives.

stories.title: Australian Researchers Reveal How Natural Killer Cells Fight Tumors
stories.summary:
A recent scientific review published in Nature Cancer highlights that natural killer (NK) cells do more than destroy tumor cells on contact; they also help coordinate and activate other parts of the immune system to combat cancer. Led by Dr. Nicholas D. Huntington at Monash University and the University of Melbourne, the study reveals that NK cells are vital for initiating and maintaining inflammation inside tumors.

Unlike T cells, NK cells can recognize and eliminate cancer cells without requiring prior exposure. They release chemical signals that recruit dendritic cells to the tumor site. Dendritic cells then ingest pieces of tumors and present them to T cells, sparking a focused immune response. When activated, dendritic cells produce interleukin-12 (IL-12), which prompts NK cells to release interferon-gamma, creating a feedback loop that enhances antigen presentation and draws additional immune cells into the fight.

However, this coordination frequently breaks down in established solid tumors. Although NK cells effectively clear cancer cells in the bloodstream, solid tumors deplete oxygen and glucose, accumulate waste products, and emit signals that suppress NK cells and disrupt their communication with dendritic cells. Dr. Huntington noted that repairing these signaling pathways could help overcome resistance to existing immunotherapies, prompting researchers to focus on restoring cellular teamwork rather than simply increasing the aggressiveness of NK cells.

Clinical trials are currently testing various combination therapies to leverage these immune mechanisms. For instance, a clinical trial for advanced melanoma utilizing localized IL-12 gene therapy alongside an immune checkpoint inhibitor achieved a 41 percent response rate, with 36 percent of patients experiencing complete responses. Additional studies are exploring FLT3 ligand to support dendritic cell growth alongside melanoma vaccines, aiming to enhance overall cancer treatment efficacy.

stories.title: Pakistani Prime Minister Seeks Easier Bank Loans for Small Businesses
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif instructed officials to streamline loan processes for small and medium enterprises (SMEs) to stimulate economic growth, increase employment, and foster entrepreneurship. During a high-level meeting in Islamabad, the premier proposed utilizing alternative collateral, such as export data from the Pakistan Single Window and supply chain participation through Exim Insurance and digital invoicing. He also recommended evaluating loan eligibility based on cash flow and reviewing existing prudential regulations.

To expedite lending, the prime minister mandated that banks receive access to relevant data held by state institutions. He emphasized that financial institutions should offer comprehensive support, including loans, Letters of Credit, and bank guarantees, while rewarding lenders that meet specific SME financing targets. Representatives at the meeting noted that banks aim to provide Rs2,000 billion in loans and reach 775,000 borrowers by June 2028.

In a separate session regarding the Pakistan Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (PCSIR), the prime minister underscored the institution's potential to drive export-led growth. He directed all PCSIR laboratories to secure international standard accreditations to validate export products and called for enhanced cooperation with the National Vocational and Technical Training Commission for youth technical training. A newly formed committee will review the PCSIR's mandate, performance, and future economic contributions.

Additionally, Power Minister Awais Ahmed Khan Leghari briefed Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on the Power Division and the 11th session of the Pakistan-Russia Inter-Governmental Commission. The premier also met with Minister for Railways Hanif Abbasi to discuss the timely completion of ongoing railway projects. The meetings highlight government efforts to enhance institutional efficiency across multiple sectors.

stories.title: Kuwaiti Authorities Arrest Two Individuals in Drug Possession Case
stories.summary:
Kuwait's Criminal Security Sector, operating through the General Department for Drug Control, has arrested two individuals, including a member of the ruling family, on charges involving the possession of narcotics and psychotropic substances. The arrest was reported by The Arab Times Online on Saturday.

According to the Ministry of Interior, the security operation led to the seizure of multiple illicit substances and equipment. The recovered items included 1.2 kilograms of hashish, one Lyrica capsule, 262 Lyrica tablets, 2,000 Tramadol tablets, approximately 100 suspected Xanax tablets, 38 other suspected narcotic tablets, and four sensitive weighing scales. Legal procedures have been initiated to transfer both suspects and the confiscated items to the Narcotics Prosecution for subsequent legal actions.

The Ministry of Interior issued a statement emphasizing its dedication to upholding the rule of law and applying it equally to all citizens without discrimination or exception. The ministry stressed that no individual is above the law and that the fundamental principles of justice and equality apply universally, regardless of social status.

This arrest follows earlier high-profile investigations in Kuwait regarding citizenship fraud. A separate extraordinary case uncovered a complex network involving two brothers and approximately 100 people whose identities and family relationships were manipulated across citizenship files, including fraudulent marriage registrations and sibling identity falsifications.

stories.title: Indian Police Use Water Cannons Against Protesting Congress Activists
stories.summary:
Police in the northern Indian state of Haryana deployed water cannons to disperse activists from the main opposition Congress party who were demonstrating outside Meta's offices. The protest was organized to voice opposition against allegations that the technology company is censoring political opposition voices in India.

Members of the youth wing of the Congress party gathered outside Meta's regional offices, accusing the tech giant of favoring Prime Minister Narendra Modi's ruling Bharatiya Janata Party. The dispute represents a significant challenge for Meta in its largest user market. While Meta has not commented publicly on the demonstrations, individuals familiar with the matter stated that the company conveyed neutrality toward all political parties during a closed-door meeting with Congress representatives, maintaining that its content restrictions adhere strictly to local laws.

Tensions escalated during the protest when police used water cannons and sprayed demonstrators with dirty water. The opposition's youth wing criticized the police response on social media platform X, accusing the government of using force against citizens exercising their right to protest for freedom of expression. A Reuters witness confirmed that several party supporters were temporarily detained by police before being released later.

The conflict arises as the Congress party prepares for state elections next year, where platforms like Facebook and Instagram are expected to serve as vital campaigning arenas. The youth wing has previously taken legal action against both Meta and the Indian government, attempting to invalidate a rule that mandates automated sweeps to remove copies of posts flagged by government takedown orders.

stories.title: اسلام آباد میں سی ڈی اے کی کارروائی، مولانا فضل الرحمٰن کی رہائش گاہ سیل
stories.summary:
کیپیٹل ڈیولپمنٹ اتھارٹی نے سنیچر کے روز اسلام آباد میں جمعیت علمائے اسلام (ف) کے سربراہ مولانا فضل الرحمٰن کی رہائش گاہ کو سیل کر دیا۔ جے یو آئی نے اس کارروائی کو سیاسی انتقام قرار دیتے ہوئے سخت احتجاج کیا ہے، جبکہ پارٹی رہنما شاہدہ اختر علی کا کہنا ہے کہ اہل خانہ کو گھر خالی کرنے کے لیے صرف تیس منٹ کا مختصر وقت دیا گیا۔

شاہدہ اختر علی نے دعویٰ کیا کہ کارروائی کے دوران گھر میں بچے اور پاؤں کے فریکچر والی خاتون سمیت دیگر افراد موجود تھے جنہیں بغیر کسی تحریری نوٹس کے باہر نکالا گیا۔ انہوں نے یہ بھی دعویٰ کیا کہ مولانا کے صاحبزادے مولانا اسجد محمود کو پولیس اپنے ساتھ لے گئی ہے، تاہم اسلام آباد پولیس نے اس گرفتاری کی تردید کرتے ہوئے خبروں کو بے بنیاد قرار دیا ہے۔

وفاقی وزیر مملکت برائے داخلہ طلال چوہدری نے اس معاملے پر وضاحت دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ یہ کارروائی کسی سیاسی وابستگی کی وجہ سے نہیں بلکہ جعلی دستاویزات اور غیر قانونی جائیداد کے خلاف کی گئی۔ ان کے مطابق یہ مکان امان اللہ نامی شخص کے نام پر تھا جو کہ غیر ملکی ہے اور اس کا پاکستانی شناختی کارڈ منسوخ ہو چکا ہے۔

انتظامیہ کا مؤقف ہے کہ 26 نومبر کو مالک کو طلبی کا نوٹس جاری کیا گیا تھا مگر پیش نہ ہونے پر پلاٹ کی الاٹمنٹ منسوخ کر دی گئی۔ جے یو آئی کے سینیٹر کامران مرتضیٰ نے اس کارروائی کو تنقید کا نشانہ بناتے ہوئے کہا کہ اگر کوئی تنازع تھا تو اسے قانونی طریقے سے حل کیا جانا چاہیے تھا جبکہ جماعت نے اپنے کارکنوں کو تحمل کا مظاہرہ کرنے کی ہدایت کی ہے۔

stories.title: Indian Police Fire Water Cannons at Congress Protesters Outside Meta Offices
stories.summary:
Law enforcement officials in the northern Indian state of Haryana deployed water cannons to disperse demonstrators from the opposition Congress party. The youth wing of the party organized the protests outside Meta installations to voice anger over accusations that the tech giant favors Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s Bharatiya Janata Party by suppressing opposition voices.

Demonstrators expressed frustration that Meta's content policies place the opposition at a disadvantage ahead of upcoming state elections, where Facebook and Instagram are anticipated to serve as vital campaigning tools. While Meta maintains that its local content restrictions comply with domestic laws, the company has faced intense scrutiny and a lawsuit from the Congress youth wing over automated rules that mandate the removal of flagged posts.

During the demonstration in Gurugram, activists stated they were targeted with pressurized water and that a small number of supporters were briefly detained by police before being released. The political controversy underscores ongoing tensions regarding social media governance, free expression, and digital campaign fairness in India's vast digital marketplace.

Although Meta has not issued a public statement addressing the demonstrations, representatives communicated privately with Congress officials to assert neutrality toward all political parties. The protests highlight the high stakes of content moderation as political factions vie for influence ahead of crucial electoral contests.

stories.title: First Pakistani Astronaut Zeeshan Ali Speaks with Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif from Space
stories.summary:
Pakistan's pioneering astronaut, Zeeshan Ali, engaged in a phone conversation from orbit with Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir. Speaking aboard the Shenzhou-24 mission, Ali described the immense pride of representing his country from 400 kilometers above the Earth while traveling at a speed of 7.9 kilometers per second.

Ali achieved a historic milestone for Pakistan's space program by becoming the first national to reach orbit, as well as the first international astronaut to step inside China's Tiangong space station. During the call, he expressed gratitude for the national support and confirmed that all operational aspects of the mission were proceeding smoothly according to schedule.

The astronaut emphasized his dedication to fulfilling his responsibilities and executing scientific research tasks to meet the expectations of the entire nation. His mission marks a significant achievement in space exploration for Pakistan and reflects Beijing's broader initiatives in space diplomacy.

The landmark flight strengthens international cooperation in space endeavors and highlights Pakistan's growing participation in manned spaceflight missions alongside international partners.

stories.title: Apple Introduces MacBook Pro 14 Featuring 2nm M6 Chip and Extended Battery Life
stories.summary:
Apple has integrated its brand-new M6 system-on-a-chip into the base MacBook Pro 14, marking the first time a laptop processor utilizes a 2nm manufacturing process. This architectural advancement delivers notable improvements in both processing performance and energy efficiency compared to previous generations.

The M6 processor excels in single-core tasks, enabling the entry-level MacBook Pro 14 to surpass more expensive configurations that still rely on M5 Pro or M5 Max chips. Furthermore, its integrated graphics processing unit offers competitive speeds for everyday tasks and casual gaming, while the inclusion of a cooling fan helps maintain thermal stability under heavy workloads.

Despite using a single-fan cooling solution that activates sooner than the dual-fan systems found in pricier variants, the laptop manages thermal output effectively. The device retains the established mini-LED display, providing high visual quality while avoiding the significantly higher cost associated with alternative OLED panel options.

Enhanced energy efficiency translates to a longer operational runtime, achieving 18.5 hours in standard Wi-Fi battery tests at 150 nits. With a list price set at €2,299, the new model offers strong multimedia capabilities and strong value proposition as a primary consumer laptop.

stories.title: مولانا فضل الرحمٰن کا اسلام آباد والا گھر غیر ملکی کے نام پر تھا، فیصل کریم کنڈی
stories.summary:
خیبر پختونخوا کے گورنر فیصل کریم کنڈی نے ڈیرہ اسماعیل خان میں میڈیا سے گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ مولانا فضل الرحمٰن کا اسلام آباد والا گھر خالی کر کے گرا دیا گیا ہے اور یہ جائیداد کسی افغان شہری کے نام پر تھی جس کا شناختی کارڈ بلاک تھا۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ مولانا کے بیٹے اسجد کی گرفتاری کے حوالے سے کوئی سرکاری اطلاع نہیں ہے اور نہ ہی ان پر کوئی ایف آئی آر درج ہے۔

گورنر نے اس موقع پر گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ صدر آصف علی زرداری جب بھی لاہور آتے ہیں تو سیاسی شخصیات سے ملاقاتیں کرتے ہیں، جبکہ نئے صوبوں کے قیام کے لیے پارلیمنٹ کا ادارہ موجود ہے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ صوبائی حکومت دہشت گردی کے خلاف جنگ میں مکمل تعاون نہیں کر رہی تھی مگر یہ ناسور اب جلد ختم ہو جائے گا۔

فیصل کریم کنڈی نے جمہوریت میں پرامن احتجاج کے حق کا اعتراف کیا لیکن ساتھ ہی یہ بھی واضح کیا کہ اگر کوئی جماعت سرکاری املاک کو نقصان پہنچائے یا سڑکیں بند کرے تو اس کے خلاف قانون کے مطابق گرفتاریاں عمل میں لائی جانی چاہئیں۔

اس پریس کانفرنس کے دوران انہوں نے صوبے کے مختلف انتظامی امور اور دہشت گردی کے خلاف اقدامات پر بھی روشنی ڈالی۔ ان کے مطابق سیاسی سرگرمیوں اور جمہوریت کے دائرہ کار میں تمام جماعتوں کو اپنے حقوق کا استعمال آئین کے اندر رہ کر کرنا چاہیے۔

stories.title: صدر آصف علی زرداری کا دورہ لاہور، وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی کی رہائش گاہ آمد
stories.summary:
مملکت کے صدر آصف علی زرداری اپنے دو روزہ دورے کے دوران لاہور میں وزیر داخلہ محسن نقوی کی رہائش گاہ گلبرگ پہنچے۔ ذرائع کے مطابق اس ملاقات کے دوران ملک کی مجموعی سیاسی اور سکیورٹی صورتحال پر تفصیلی تبادلہ خیال کیا گیا۔

اس اہم ملاقات میں دیگر نمایاں شخصیات بھی شریک تھیں جن میں اسپیکر پنجاب اسمبلی ملک احمد خان، گورنر پنجاب سردار سلیم حیدر اور راجہ پرویز اشرف شامل تھے۔ ملاقات کے بعد صدر آصف علی زرداری لاہور کا دورہ مکمل کر کے واپس اسلام آباد روانہ ہو گئے۔

یہ دورہ ایسے وقت میں ہوا جب ملک میں مختلف سیاسی جماعتوں کے درمیان بات چیت اور ملاقاتوں کا سلسلہ جاری ہے۔ صدر کے اس دورے کو سیاسی حلقوں میں خاص اہمیت کی نگاہ سے دیکھا جا رہا ہے جہاں اہم رہنماؤں نے باہمی امور پر مشاورت کی۔

ملاقات کے بعد تمام شرکاء نے اپنے طے شدہ مصروفات کے مطابق امور کی انجام دہی جاری رکھی اور صدر کے اس دورے کی تکمیل کے ساتھ ہی وہ دارالحکومت واپس پہنچ گئے۔

stories.title: وزیر اعظم شہباز شریف کی کویت پر ڈرون حملے کی شدید مذمت
stories.summary:
وزیر اعظم شہباز شریف نے کویت پر ہونے والے حالیہ ڈرون حملے کی پرزور مذمت کرتے ہوئے برادر اسلامی ملک کی قیادت اور عوام کے ساتھ مکمل یکجہتی کا اظہار کیا ہے۔ انہوں نے اس عزم کا اعادہ کیا کہ پاکستان کویت کی خود مختاری، سلامتی اور علاقائی سالمیت کی غیر متزلزل حمایت جاری رکھے گا۔

وزیر اعظم نے حملے کے نتیجے میں متاثر ہونے والے افراد کے لواحقین سے گہرے دکھ اور رنج کا اظہار کیا۔ انہوں نے اس حملے میں زخمی ہونے والے ایک پاکستانی شہری سمیت دیگر تمام افراد کی جلد اور مکمل صحت یابی کے لیے دعا کی۔

حکومت کی سطح پر اقدامات کا ذکر کرتے ہوئے وزیر اعظم نے بتایا کہ کویت میں قائم پاکستانی سفارتخانہ وہاں کے حکام کے ساتھ مسلسل رابطے میں ہے۔ سفارتخانے کی جانب سے زخمی ہونے والے پاکستانی شہری کو ہر ممکنہ ضروری معاونت اور سہولیات فراہم کی جا رہی ہیں۔

یہ بیان پاکستان کی طرف سے خلیجی خطے کے امن اور برادر ممالک کے ساتھ تعلقات کی مضبوطی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ وزیر اعظم نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ کویت کی علاقائی سلامتی کا مکمل احترام کیا جانا چاہیے۔

stories.title: گورنر سندھ نہال ہاشمی کا صوبے بھر کے دوروں اور سیاسی ہم آہنگی کا اعلان
stories.summary:
گورنر سندھ نہال ہاشمی نے کراچی میں ایک پریس کانفرنس کے دوران اعلان کیا ہے کہ وہ پورے سندھ کا دورہ کریں گے اور وہ تمام سیاسی جماعتوں کے گورنر ہیں۔ انہوں نے بتایا کہ بابائے قوم قائد اعظم کی 150 ویں سالگرہ اور یوم پیدائش بھرپور جوش و خروش کے ساتھ منائی جائے گی۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ قائد اعظم نے اپنے آخری ایام اسی گورنر ہاؤس سندھ میں گزارے تھے، اور 25 دسمبر کو ان کی سالگرہ کے ساتھ وزیراعظم نواز شریف کی سالگرہ کا کیک بھی کاٹا جائے گا۔

نہال ہاشمی نے مزید کہا کہ پاکستان ووٹ کے ذریعے قائم ہوا تھا اور جو لوگ ملک کی خدمت کرتے ہیں انہیں تمغہ جناح سے نوازا جائے گا۔ اس موقع پر کراچی کی مرکزی شاہراہوں کو قائداعظم کی بڑی تصاویر سے سجایا جائے گا جبکہ درس گاہوں میں جا کر طلبہ کو ان کے افکار سے آگاہ کیا جائے گا۔ انہوں نے مزید تصدیق کی کہ 25 دسمبر کو وزیراعظم شہباز شریف مزار قائد کا دورہ کریں گے۔

اس پریس کانفرنس کے علاوہ ملک بھر سے دیگر سیاسی اور انتظامی خبریں بھی سامنے آئیں جن میں وزیراعظم شہباز شریف کی جانب سے کویت پر ڈرون حملے کی مذمت شامل ہے۔ وزیراعلیٰ پنجاب مریم نواز نے تلہ گنگ کو ضلع بنانے کا اعلان کیا اور بچیوں کو خواتین کے تحفظ کی موبائل ایپلی کیشن لازمی ڈاؤن لوڈ کرنے کی ہدایت کی۔

دریں اثنا، پی ٹی اے نے ملک بھر میں انٹرنیٹ سروسز کی معمول کے مطابق بحالی کی تصدیق کی ہے۔ خیبرپختونخوا میں قوانین کی خلافورزیوں پر جرمانوں اور قید کا نیا شیڈول سرکاری گزٹ میں شائع ہو چکا ہے جبکہ سی ٹی ڈی نے صوبے میں دس ماہ اور دس دن کے دوران مارے گئے اور گرفتار دہشت گردوں کی رپورٹ جاری کی ہے۔

دیگر شخصیات میں فیصل کریم کنڈی نے کہا کہ آصف زرداری لاہور میں سیاسی ملاقاتیں کرتے ہیں اور نئے صوبوں کے لیے پارلیمنٹ موجود ہے۔ فاروق ستار نے خبردار کیا کہ قوم پرستوں کو اجازت دینا سندھو دیش کی راہ ہموار کرنا ہے جبکہ مرتضیٰ وہاب نے نارتھ ناظم آباد کی سخی حسن اسٹریٹ پر جاری ترقیاتی کام پر روشنی ڈالی۔

stories.title: MQM-P Cancels November 29 Rally Over Security Concerns and Allegations
stories.summary:
The Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan (MQM-P) called off its planned rally and congregation scheduled for November 29. The announcement was made during a press conference held at the party’s headquarters in Bahadurabad by MQM-P leaders Dr. Farooq Sattar and Federal Minister for Health Syed Mustafa Kamal.

Party leadership explained that law enforcement agencies warned of a high terrorism risk associated with the gathering. Officials noted that the party chose to cancel the event to prevent any potential law and order disruption, emphasizing a commitment to public safety and patriotism. A new date for the postponed rally is slated for announcement sometime in December.

During the briefing, leaders criticized the Sindh government for allegedly treating political groups unfairly. They claimed authorities acted in a discriminatory manner by permitting a separate rally organized by nationalist factions while denying MQM-P permission. Furthermore, they alleged that these rival groups included elements backed by the Pakistan Peoples Party (PPP) and organizations previously proscribed by the National Counter Terrorism Authority (NACTA).

The cancellation underscores heightened political tensions in the region. MQM-P representatives expressed deep concern over recent statements from political figures and maintained that their decision reflects a vital priority to preserve peace and stability in urban centers like Karachi, Hyderabad, Sukkur, and Mirpurkhas.

stories.title: Prime Minister and Army Chief Speak with Pakistan's First Astronaut
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Chief of Army Staff and Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir engaged in a live conversation with Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, Pakistan’s first astronaut. Ali is currently stationed aboard China’s Tiangong Space Station as part of a landmark milestone for the nation's space program.

The high-level interaction took place during a visit by the leaders to the Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission (SUPARCO) facility located in Islamabad. Prime Minister Sharif praised the achievement as the official beginning of Pakistan's human spaceflight initiative, emphasizing that outer space exploration should serve peaceful purposes and the greater good of humanity.

Highlighting international collaboration, the prime minister noted that the mission coincides with the 75th anniversary of diplomatic ties between Pakistan and China. He thanked Chinese President Xi Jinping for incorporating Pakistan as the first foreign partner in the Chinese space venture. Field Marshal Asim Munir also commended the astronaut, stating that the historic flight demonstrates the profound and growing strategic partnership uniting Pakistan and China.

During the transmission, astronaut Muhammad Zeeshan Ali expressed immense pride in representing his country as the first international explorer aboard the Tiangong station. According to SUPARCO officials, Ali is actively conducting four distinct scientific experiments designed by Pakistani universities alongside his Chinese crewmates, marking a significant advancement for national scientific research.

stories.title: India Asks Netflix to Block Pakistan's First Original Drama Series
stories.summary:
The government of India officially requested that Netflix restrict the availability of Pakistani content within the country, specifically targeting the platform's upcoming romantic drama series. The request follows formal pressure from the All Indian Cine Workers Association directed at Prime Minister Narendra Modi, urging authorities to prevent the release of the show.

The targeted program, titled 'Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo' and internationally known as 'All the Love Our Hearts Carry,' features prominent actors Fawad Khan and Mahira Khan. Based on a story about individuals from three generations meeting in Italy, the series was scheduled for a December 4 release. Indian ministry officials cited an existing advisory from May 2025 to justify maintaining restrictions on Pakistani media following past cross-border military tensions.

The directive has sparked widespread discussion regarding the intersection of geopolitics and global entertainment. Pakistani Federal Minister for Planning and Development Ahsan Iqbal strongly criticized the move on social media, accusing authorities of weaponizing art, culture, and television broadcasts as national security concerns rather than allowing audiences freely to choose their media.

Industry insiders emphasize that Pakistani television dramas command a massive international audience across South Asia, the Gulf, and Western diaspora communities. While traditional cinema exchanges between the two nations remain halted, streaming platforms have increasingly served as a crucial cross-border avenue for storytelling, making this restriction a notable hurdle for broader cultural exchange.

stories.title: School Blast in Eastern Afghanistan Kills Seven Students and Injures Many
stories.summary:
An explosion near a school in Afghanistan’s northeastern Kunar province resulted in the deaths of seven students and left up to 99 others injured. The incident took place in the Andarsir area located within the Asadabad district, an administrative region bordering neighboring Pakistan that hosts numerous commercial mining operations.

According to Abdul Mateen Qani, a spokesperson for the Afghan Taliban Interior Ministry, initial evaluations suggest the blast originated at a nearby depot used by mining companies to store explosives. Sami-ul-Haq Haq Bayan, head of Kunar’s department of information and culture, added that the explosion occurred unintentionally inside a residential building close to Shagai Middle School while workers were actively preparing materials for rock blasting.

Provincial hospital medical officials confirmed receiving seven fatalities alongside dozens of wounded individuals, warning that the final casualty count could potentially rise. Local authorities immediately launched a comprehensive investigation to determine the exact circumstances surrounding the tragedy and promised to release further findings once inquiries conclude.

The devastating event adds to ongoing concerns regarding civilian safety and child welfare across Afghanistan. Earlier in the year, a separate educational center explosion in the capital city of Kabul wounded dozens of children, highlighting persistent hazards related to unsecured explosive materials near populated learning environments.

stories.title: Rockstar Releases First GTA 6 Update, Sparking Graphics Downgrade Debate
stories.summary:
Rockstar has rolled out the inaugural post-launch update for Grand Theft Auto 6, version 01.002.002, designed to address freezing issues, static weather patterns, and other technical hiccups. However, the patch has inadvertently triggered a wave of complaints from players on PS5 and PS5 Pro consoles who claim the patch reduced overall visual fidelity to enhance system performance.

Gamers taking to Reddit have pointed out multiple graphical downgrades following the update, highlighting blurry textures, increased asset pop-in, and less convincing global illumination. Specific grievances involve dynamic weather elements on the PS5 Pro edition, where sunsets, sunrises, pixelated cloud formations, and post-rain water reflections appear notably diminished compared to the game's initial launch state.

While the PS5 Pro enhancements aim to optimize performance, tech analysis by Digital Foundry indicates that hardware remains heavily taxed in dense areas even with a 30 frames-per-second cap. Diminishing visual quality may serve to alleviate hardware strain, though fans have drawn comparisons to similar visual complaints during Red Dead Redemption 2's early patch cycle on previous-generation pro consoles.

As the gaming community awaits an official response from Rockstar regarding these performance adjustments, analytical outlets plan to continuously monitor visual changes in future updates. Meanwhile, political developments in Pakistan saw the Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan cancel a scheduled rally and congregation in Karachi.

stories.title: انڈیا کے چیف آف ڈیفنس سٹاف کا پاکستان کی خلائی ترقی پر اظہار تشویش
stories.summary:
انڈیا کے چیف آف ڈیفنس سٹاف جنرل این ایس راجا سبرامنی نے جمعے کو نئی دہلی میں ایک تقریب سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے تسلیم کیا ہے کہ چین کی معاونت سے پاکستان کی خلائی شعبے میں صلاحیتیں بڑھ رہی ہیں اور مستقبل میں اسے ترکی کی مدد بھی مل سکتی ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ انٹیلیجنس، نگرانی اور جاسوسی کی بہتر صلاحیتوں کے تناظر میں انڈیا کو اپنی دفاعی حکمتِ عملی بناتے ہوئے اس پیش رفت کو مدنظر رکھنا ہوگا۔

اس بیان سے چند روز قبل 25 نومبر 2026 کو پاکستانی شہری محمد ذیشان علی چینی شین ژو-24 مشن کے ذریعے خلا میں جانے والے پہلے پاکستانی بنے ہیں۔ وہ چین کے تیانگونگ خلائی سٹیشن پر چھ دن قیام کے دوران سائنسی تجربات میں حصہ لے رہے ہیں، جسے پاکستان اور چین کے درمیان طویل مدتی خلائی تعاون کا تسلسل قرار دیا جا رہا ہے۔

جنرل راجا سبرامنی کے اس بیان پر سوشل میڈیا پر ملے جلے ردعمل سامنے آئے ہیں۔ جہاں کچھ انڈین صارفین نے اسے حقیقت پسندانہ قرار دیا، وہیں تنقید کرنے والوں نے پاکستان کے خلائی پروگرام میں ماضی کی دیگر عالمی امداد کا ذکر کیا اور دونوں ممالک کے دفاعی بجٹ کا موازنہ بھی کیا۔

انڈیا اس صورتحال کے جواب میں اپنی دفاعی و خلائی صلاحیتوں کو مزید مستحکم کرنے پر کام کر رہا ہے۔ جنرل سبرامنی کے مطابق، خلائی نگرانی کے تیسرے مرحلے کا پروگرام انڈیا کی نگرانی کی صلاحیت کو نمایاں طور پر بڑھائے گا، جبکہ اضافی سیٹلائٹس کی تیاری کے لیے نجی شعبے کے اداروں سے بھی تعاون کیا جا رہا ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistani Leaders Call Astronaut Zeeshan Ali Aboard Chinese Space Station
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir conversed via telephone with Pakistani astronaut Wing Commander Zeeshan Ali, who is currently stationed aboard China's Tiangong space station. Ali achieved a historic national milestone on Wednesday by becoming the first Pakistani in orbit and the first international astronaut to board the Chinese orbital facility during the Shenzhou-24 mission.

The high-level call took place from the headquarters of the Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission in Islamabad, with Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar and Chinese Ambassador Jiang Zaidong also present. Prime Minister Shehbaz lauded Ali's accomplishment as a historic moment for Pakistan's 240 million citizens, while Field Marshal Munir praised the mission as a testament to the enduring strategic partnership between Pakistan and China.

Responding to the leadership, Ali expressed immense pride in representing Pakistan 400 kilometers above Earth while travelling at a speed of 7.9 kilometers per second. He confirmed that all scientific research activities and payload operations are proceeding according to plan inside the orbital laboratories alongside his Chinese crewmates, commander Tang Hongbo and flight engineer Wu Yi.

Prime Minister Shehbaz thanked Chinese President Xi Jinping for incorporating Pakistan into Beijing's space program during the celebration of 75 years of diplomatic relations. The premier emphasized that outer space must be utilized strictly for peaceful purposes and humanity's collective well-being, while Ali encouraged Pakistani youth to pursue excellence in science and technology.

stories.title: Death Toll Reaches 12 in Karachi Building Collapse as Search Continues
stories.summary:
Emergency response teams in Karachi recovered four additional bodies from the wreckage of a six-storey under-construction building near Baloch Colony, raising the confirmed death toll to 12. The structure, reportedly built illegally on a residential plot, collapsed unexpectedly earlier in the week, prompting extensive urban search and rescue operations involving heavy machinery and manual debris clearance.

Relatives have registered approximately eight missing individuals at an information desk established at the disaster site. Amid ongoing search efforts, rescue personnel recently achieved a breakthrough by pulling 28-year-old Muhammad Adil alive from the debris after he survived trapped beneath the rubble for 54 hours. Sindh Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah hailed the survival as a miraculous event and urged rescue agencies to expedite the search for any remaining survivors.

In response to the tragedy, the Sindh government initiated sweeping administrative measures, removing Sindh Local Government Secretary Waseem Shamshad, East Deputy Commissioner Nasrullah Abbasi, and SSP East Zubair Sheikh over administrative negligence. Furthermore, authorities suspended 16 officials from the Sindh Building Control Authority and ordered the immediate arrest of the building's owner, Salman Tahir, alongside the builder, while the architect and structural engineer face formal investigative scrutiny.

The Karachi Commissioner's Office submitted a compliance report indicating that an ongoing crackdown on unauthorized developments has resulted in the sealing of 516 buildings across various city districts. A formal first information report invoking severe legal provisions including intentional murder has been filed at the Tipu Sultan police station against multiple project stakeholders for utilizing substandard construction materials.

stories.title: Pakistan Envoy Visits Injured Citizen in Kuwait Following Drone Attack
stories.summary:
Pakistan’s Ambassador to Kuwait, Dr. Zafar Iqbal, visited a local hospital to check on the condition of a Pakistani citizen who sustained injuries in a drone attack. The hospital visit was carried out on the specific directives of Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif, who instructed the diplomatic mission to closely monitor the victim's welfare and ensure access to proper medical care.

During his hospital visit, Ambassador Dr. Iqbal met directly with the injured citizen and received an extensive medical briefing from the attending doctors regarding his ongoing treatment and health status. The medical team reported that the patient is currently in stable condition and is expected to achieve a full recovery in the near future.

Following the hospital visit, the ambassador met with Lieutenant General Khaled Daraj Saad Al-Shariaan, the Chief of the General Staff of the Kuwaiti Armed Forces. During their discussions, Lieutenant General Al-Shariaan assured the Pakistani envoy that the injured citizen would receive comprehensive medical treatment and full care facilities.

The diplomatic engagement highlights ongoing efforts by the Pakistani government to protect and support its nationals abroad during security incidents. Prime Minister Sharif had explicitly commanded the embassy to oversee all measures necessary for the citizen's medical recovery and immediate care.

stories.title: مریم نواز کا تلہ گنگ کا دورہ، ضلع بنانے کا اعلان اور دو ارب روپے دینے کی بات
stories.summary:
وزیر اعلیٰ پنجاب مریم نواز نے تلہ گنگ کا دورہ کیا اور وہاں ایک تقریب سے خطاب کیا۔ اپنے بیان میں انہوں نے کہا کہ تلہ گنگ میں ہیلی کاپٹر لینڈ ہونے پر وہ حیران رہ گئیں اور اس علاقے کے عوام کے لیے نیک خواہشات کا اظہار کیا۔

دورے کے دوران وزیر اعلیٰ پنجاب نے تلہ گنگ کو باقاعدہ طور پر ضلع بنانے کا اہم اعلان کیا۔ انہوں نے علاقے کی ترقی کے لیے دو ارب روپے دینے کا وعدہ بھی کیا اور یقین دہانی کرائی کہ آئندہ دو سالوں میں اس علاقے کی تقدیر کو مکمل طور پر تبدیل کر دیا جائے گا۔

مریم نواز نے اپنے خطاب کے دوران اس بات پر زور دیا کہ صرف جھوٹے وعدے کرنے والے پیچھے رہ گئے ہیں جبکہ ان کی حکومت عملی اقدامات پر یقین رکھتی ہے۔ انہوں نے تقریب میں موجود بچیوں کو خواتین کے تحفظ کے لیے بنائی گئی خصوصی موبائل ایپلی کیشن لازمی ڈاؤن لوڈ کرنے کی ہدایت بھی کی۔

stories.title: خیبر پختونخوا میں قوانین کی خلاف ورزیوں پر سزاؤں اور جرمانوں کا نیا گزٹ جاری
stories.summary:
صوبہ خیبر پختونخوا میں قوانین اور قواعد و ضوابط کی خلاف ورزی کرنے والوں کے خلاف سخت کارروائیوں کا نیا شیڈول سرکاری گزٹ میں شائع کر دیا گیا ہے۔ پشاور سے جاری ہونے والے اس مسودے میں مختلف جرائم کے لیے قید اور جرمانوں کی واضح تفصیلات بیان کی گئی ہیں۔

نئے قوانین کے تحت سرکاری احکامات میں رکاوٹ ڈالنے، غیر قانونی اجتماعات منعقد کرنے اور ماحولیاتی آلودگی پھیلانے والوں کے خلاف فوری کارروائی عمل میں لائی جائے گی۔ اس کے علاوہ عوامی مقامات پر غیر محفوظ ٹرانسپورٹ، کشتیوں کے استعمال، زِپ لائنز اور کان کنی کے غیر محفوظ آپریشنز کو بھی قانون کے دائرے میں لایا گیا ہے۔

گزٹ مسودے کے مطابق فٹ پاتھوں اور سڑکوں پر تجاوزات قائم کرنے پر بیس ہزار روپے جرمانہ ہوگا۔ دکانوں، ہوٹلوں اور عوامی مقامات پر صفائی کے ناقص انتظامات پر بھی بیس ہزار روپے تک کا جرمانہ عائد کیا جائے گا۔

نئے قواعد کے تحت پبلک ٹرانسپورٹ میں مقررہ حد سے زیادہ کرایہ وصول کرنے والوں کو بیس ہزار روپے جبکہ لاؤڈ اسپیکر کی مقررہ حد کی خلاف ورزی کرنے پر پندره ہزار روپے تک کا جرمانہ دینا ہوگا۔

stories.title: First Pakistani Astronaut in Space Encourages Youth to Study Science
stories.summary:
Zeeshan Ali, the first Pakistani national to travel into Earth's orbit and board China’s Tiangong space station, encouraged young people to focus on education, science, and technology. Speaking live from approximately 400 kilometers above Earth during a communication with Pakistani leadership at Suparco, the 40-year-old former Pakistan Air Force pilot expressed hope that future generations of scientists and engineers will explore deeper into space.

Ali's mission began when he traveled aboard the Shenzhou-24 spacecraft as a payload specialist, working alongside mission commander Tang Hongbo and flight engineer Wu Yi. His current duties involve executing four joint Pakistan-China research projects focusing on materials science and biotechnology, including studies on microgravity effects on quinoa seeds, microalgae, cyanobacteria, and carbon-fiber composites.

Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, joined by Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Asim Munir and Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar, congratulated Ali during the live interaction. Sharif praised the astronaut for inspiring a new generation to push boundaries as Pakistan and China celebrate 75 years of diplomatic relations. The mission follows Ali's selection in April 2026 and seven months of rigorous training at the Astronaut Centre of China in Beijing.

The historic journey marks a major milestone in bilateral scientific cooperation and technological development between Pakistan and China. Leaders from both nations emphasized the importance of the mission in opening new avenues for aerospace research and inspiring youth participation in advanced scientific fields.

stories.title: Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari Discusses Past PPP and PML-N Political Rivalries
stories.summary:
PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari reflected on historical political tensions between his party and the PML-N, noting that leaders from both factions have learned from past mistakes regarding development projects. Speaking at the foundation-laying ceremony of a Sindh Institute of Urology and Transplantation (SIUT) hospital in Rahim Yar Khan, Bilawal thanked Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif for allocating federal funds to Sindh and expressed gratitude to Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz for not obstructing the initiative.

Recalling past governance cycles, Bilawal described how previous administrations routinely halted projects initiated by rival parties whenever power shifted. He explained that early mistakes by party elders involved dismantling opponent-led initiatives, a cycle he hopes to break by maintaining administrative continuity for public welfare. The SIUT project in Rahim Yar Khan is part of broader provincial allocations that also target facilities in Gujjar Khan, Sargodha, Dera Ismail Khan, and Kot Addu.

Bilawal emphasized that ordinary citizens want politicians to prioritize pressing socioeconomic challenges such as rising inflation, unemployment, and financial hardships driven by regional conflicts in the Middle East. He stressed that essential public health and development programs must continue regardless of which political party holds power in Islamabad or the provinces.

The event underscored a push toward bipartisan cooperation in public service delivery and regional healthcare expansion. By acknowledging historical governance errors, the PPP leadership aimed to promote political stability and ensure the unhindered execution of tertiary care medical projects.

stories.title: Peshawar High Court Halts Deportation of Afghan Spouse for Six Months
stories.summary:
The Peshawar High Court in Pakistan has issued a written decision blocking the expulsion of an Afghan citizen married to a Pakistani woman for a period of six months. A judicial bench heard the challenge against the husband's planned deportation and ruled that the petitioner may submit a new application to NADRA to obtain a Pakistan Origin Card. According to the court's directives, the designated authority at NADRA must process the submission in accordance with applicable laws and issue a formal written notification if any errors or rejections occur.

Furthermore, the court noted that the applicant retains the legal right to seek citizenship pursuant to the Naturalization Act of 1926. The high court mandated that the interior ministry secretary must prioritize the case and reach a final determination within a six-month timeframe. The judicial order explicitly shields the Afghan spouse from being forced out of the country throughout this six-month window or until the federal administration finalizes its ruling on the matter.

In a separate diplomatic development, Pakistan's Ambassador to Kuwait, Dr. Zafar Iqbal, traveled to a local medical facility on direct instructions from Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif. The ambassador checked on the condition of a Pakistani national who sustained injuries during a drone strike. During the hospital visit, Dr. Iqbal interacted directly with the recovering citizen and received a comprehensive medical update from the attending physicians regarding his health status.

stories.title: Karachi Commissioner Submits Inspection Report Following Fatal Building Collapse
stories.summary:
Karachi Commissioner Hassan Naqvi presented an official briefing to Sindh Chief Minister Murad Ali Shah detailing a widespread municipal sweep targeting unsafe and unauthorized properties across the metropolitan area. The crackdown was initiated in the wake of a tragic structural failure in the Admin Society neighborhood that resulted in 11 fatalities. Within the update, the commissioner reported that authorities have successfully sealed 516 structures thus far, encompassing 262 unapproved properties under construction alongside 12 formal administrative warnings.

Breaking down the municipal actions by location, the commissioner outlined that District Korangi saw 41 properties sealed out of 48 checked, with seven receiving notices. Additional enforcement included 12 seals and five notices in District Keamari, eight seals in District Malir, five seals in District Central, 55 seals in District South, and 37 seals in District East. Following the submission, Chief Minister Shah instructed local government departments to maintain continuous and unyielding enforcement against all breaches of building regulations.

Concurrently, the death toll from the six-storey residential collapse inside the Administration Employees Cooperative Housing Society in the Baloch Colony sector climbed to 11. Rescue 1122 personnel pulled two additional bodies from the rubble whose identities remain unconfirmed. Search and rescue operations persist at the scene with seven individuals still unaccounted for beneath the debris. Emergency responders are deploying advanced cameras and electronic detection tools to locate potential survivors, while heavy earth-moving equipment clears away masonry. Among the survivors, a man named Adil shared his harrowing account of staying trapped under the ruins for two days by sheltering beneath a concrete pillar.

stories.title: Pakistan Internet Services Restored Following Repairs to Submarine Cable
stories.summary:
Connectivity across Pakistan has returned to normal operations following the successful repair of the SEA-ME-WE 5 international submarine cable system, the Pakistan Telecommunication Authority announced. The regulatory body confirmed that the fault on the crucial undersea network has been completely rectified, allowing the infrastructure to resume full operational capacity and bringing nationwide web traffic back to standard speeds. The rapid resolution was achieved through close coordination between Transworld Associates and the international consortium managing the cable system.

Technical crews labored continuously around the clock to isolate and fix the malfunction. To mitigate customer impact while the outage persisted, administrative teams dynamically rerouted regional digital traffic through alternative international data pathways to keep service degradation to a minimum. Earlier, the regulator had warned citizens that internet speeds and connection stability might fluctuate because the infrastructure failure occurred approximately 11 kilometers away from the country's shoreline.

During the disruption, Transworld Associates worked alongside the international consortium to diagnose the root cause and project repair timelines while utilizing alternative channels. In broader domestic updates, financial institutions received directives to simplify lending criteria for small and medium enterprises, while the Federal Board of Revenue adjusted the territorial jurisdictions for inland revenue officers across major metropolitan hubs like Karachi, Lahore, and Islamabad. Additionally, gold prices in the local market experienced a decrease of 2,300 rupees per tola.

stories.title: NCCIA Arrests 14 Individuals in Lahore Petrol Pump Fraud Scheme
stories.summary:
Law enforcement officials in Lahore have apprehended 14 individuals, including four petrol station owners and a technical installer, for operating a sophisticated fuel-cheating scam. The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency carried out targeted operations in neighborhoods such as Wapda Town and Gulshan Ravi, dismantling an illicit enterprise that reportedly defrauded motorists of approximately 400 million rupees.

Investigators uncovered a dozen digital fuel control kits hidden inside dispensing units, which were remotely manipulated using a smartphone application. While the physical meters on the pumps indicated correct fuel delivery, the unauthorized software secretly dispensed smaller amounts of fuel to unsuspecting drivers, siphoning off substantial sums of money on a daily basis.

Authorities are actively examining the software used in the operation to determine its origin and distribution network. Officials noted that similar fraudulent activities have been detected in other regions, including Sargodha and Bhalwal, prompting wider scrutiny across multiple jurisdictions.

The crackdown highlights growing concerns over digital manipulation in commercial sectors and consumer protection. By addressing these high-tech scams, the agency aims to curb financial losses for citizens and hold accountable those responsible for exploiting automated systems.

stories.title: Explosion Near Afghan School Kills Seven Students and Injures Many
stories.summary:
An explosion adjacent to a school situated in Afghanistan's northeastern Kunar province resulted in the deaths of seven students and left up to 99 other individuals wounded. The blast occurred in the Andarsir neighborhood within the Asadabad district, according to a public statement released by the spokesperson for the Taliban Interior Ministry, Abdul Mateen Qani. Initial investigative findings suggest that the detonation triggered inside a storage depot containing mining explosives located close to the educational facility.

Authorities have launched a formal investigation into the incident and promised to release comprehensive findings once the inquiry concludes. This security breach follows another educational tragedy from August, when an explosion tore through an educational center in the capital city of Kabul, leaving at least 42 children injured according to the United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan. A local hospital that admitted 35 of those wounded students reported that every affected victim was between 10 and 14 years of age.

The latest incident in Kunar province has reignited concerns regarding the safety of children and the hazardous proximity of industrial explosive storage sites to civilian population centers. Government ministries continue to face scrutiny over the regulation of explosive materials utilized by commercial mining operations operating near schools and residential zones across the country.

stories.title: Australian Selector Bailey Rejects Claims That Bancroft Missed Test Selection Over Scandal
stories.summary:
Australian chief selector George Bailey has refuted allegations that Cameron Bancroft's association with the infamous 2018 ball-tampering incident has hindered his return to the Test team. Despite consistent domestic success in the Sheffield Shield over the past six years, the 34-year-old opening batsman has repeatedly failed to secure a recall following a brief return during the 2019 Ashes series.

The controversy resurfaced after teammate Usman Khawaja alleged in his autobiography that the entire playing squad was aware of the plot to alter the ball in Cape Town. Bancroft supported these claims in a recent public statement, suggesting that lingering tensions and discomfort might have influenced selectors to bypass him to avoid reviving past controversies. Bailey firmly dismissed these assertions, stating that the historic scandal has never factored into selection discussions.

Cricket Australia has formally decided against reopening investigations into the matter, offering full backing to Test captain Pat Cummins ahead of the upcoming four-match series against New Zealand in Perth. Bailey emphasized that staff and players remain fully focused on the sporting contest despite renewed media scrutiny surrounding the historic incident.

The ongoing debate continues to draw public attention as Australia navigates leadership continuity and squad rotations following the retirement of veteran opener David Warner. Selectors maintain that sporting merit remains the sole criterion for player selection as the team prepares for the international summer schedule.

stories.title: Pakistani Leaders Connect with Astronaut Zeeshan Ali Aboard Tiangong Station
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir spoke by telephone with Pakistani astronaut Wing Commander Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, who is currently stationed on China's Tiangong space station. The high-profile call was conducted from the headquarters of the Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission in the presence of Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar and China’s Ambassador Jiang Zaidong.

Wing Commander Ali made history on Wednesday by becoming the first foreign astronaut to board the Chinese orbiting laboratory as part of the Shenzhou-24 mission. The 40-year-old pilot is serving as a payload specialist during a planned mission duration of five to ten days, participating in cultural exchanges and scientific activities alongside his Chinese crewmates.

During the mission, the crew will oversee approximately 90 experiments, including Pakistani payloads hosted in the Wentian and Mengtian laboratory modules. Research initiatives managed by the Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission involve cultivating microalgae to study potential oxygen and food sources, alongside examining how spaceflight impacts quinoa seeds.

The historic flight follows a bilateral cooperation agreement signed between Pakistan and the Chinese space agency earlier in the year. National leaders have hailed the milestone as a transformative step for domestic scientific development and a foundation for future international space exploration partnerships.

stories.title: Government Proposes Flat Fuel Cost Adjustment of Rs3.04 per Unit for Consumers
stories.summary:
The government has formally requested the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority to implement a uniform forward-looking monthly fuel cost adjustment of Rs3.04 per unit spanning from October to December. To prevent severe price shocks for consumers, regulatory authorities scheduled an emergency public hearing to evaluate the petition, with adjustments intended to reflect directly on electricity bills starting in December.

According to official submissions, the proposed rate represents an averaged calculation of varying monthly adjustments, which included requested additional charges for October, November, and December based on current market trends. Officials explained that the framework aims to establish financial predictability and maintain liquidity within the energy sector, avoiding the historical delays in cost recovery that often trigger severe cash flow crises.

Recent geopolitical tensions and regional disruptions have severely impacted international energy markets, leading to the closure of critical transit routes such as the Strait of Hormuz. Consequently, benchmark Brent crude oil prices surpassed $120 per barrel, while imported coal costs surged to $123 per tonne, significantly exceeding baseline assumptions used during initial tariff determinations.

Despite supply chain complications and force majeure declarations affecting liquefied natural gas deliveries, authorities have continued to secure contracted and spot cargoes to meet domestic demands. The proposed equalization mechanism seeks to manage these elevated international fuel expenses transparently while safeguarding power sector stability.

stories.title: ایم کیو ایم پاکستان کا سیکیورٹی خدشات کے باعث کراچی میں ریلی منسوخ کرنے کا اعلان
stories.summary:
متحدہ قومی موومنٹ پاکستان نے کراچی میں منعقد ہونے والی اپنی ریلی منسوخ کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا ہے۔ کراچی میں ایک پریس کانفرنس کے دوران ایم کیو ایم کے رہنما ڈاکٹر فاروق ستار نے بتایا کہ یہ فیصلہ سیکیورٹی خدشات اور حکومتی احکامات کی روشنی میں کیا گیا ہے۔ انہوں نے مؤقف اختیار کیا کہ سندھ حکومت کا 29 نومبر کی ریلی نہ نکالنے کا پابند کرنا انتہائی غیر منصفانہ فیصلہ ہے، اور اگر سیکیورٹی کے معاملات تھے تو حکومت کو ان سے بات کرنی چاہیے تھی۔

ڈاکٹر فاروق ستار نے تنقید کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ قوم پرست عناصر کو اجازت دینا دراصل سندھو دیش کی راہ ہموار کرنے کے مترادف ہے۔ انہوں نے مزید واضح کیا کہ کمشنر کراچی نے پولیس حکام کی سفارشات اور حکومتِ سندھ کے حکم کے تحت مزارِ قائد سمیت شارعِ فیصل پر ریلی کی اجازت دینے سے انکار کیا تھا۔

اس صورتِ حال کے پیشِ نظر پارٹی نے فی الحال کل کی طے شدہ ریلی ملتوی کر دی ہے۔ تاہم، ڈاکٹر فاروق ستار نے اعلان کیا ہے کہ آنے والے دسمبر کے مہینے میں دوبارہ ریلی نکالی جائے گی اور لاڑکانہ سمیت دیگر علاقوں کا رخ بھی کیا جائے گا۔

یہ تمام معاملہ کراچی میں سیاسی سرگرمیوں، امن و امان کی فضا اور انتظامی فیصلوں کے پس منظر میں سامنے آیا ہے۔ اس منسوخی سے جماعت کے کارکنوں میں ایک نئی سیاسی بحث چھڑ گئی ہے جبکہ مستقبل کی تاریخ کا اعلان آئندہ دنوں میں کیا جائے گا۔

stories.title: S&P Upgrades Hungary Outlook to Stable on Deficit and EU Reforms
stories.summary:
Credit rating agency S&P has adjusted Hungary's outlook from negative to stable, pointing to robust institutional and fiscal frameworks that will support a steady decline in budget deficits over the next two years. This shift is the second outlook revision in a two-week span, following six months of reforms initiated by Prime Minister Peter Magyar. These changes successfully mended relations with European Union authorities and unlocked 16.4 billion euros in previously frozen EU funds, thereby relieving anxieties regarding the nation's financial trajectory.

S&P projects that economic activity in Hungary will recover by 2027 and maintain steady growth through 2029, estimating an average expansion of 2.5% between 2028 and 2029. This represents a significant turnaround compared to years of economic stagnation under previous right-wing leader Viktor Orban. Finance Minister Andras Karman noted that the positive rating action could help stabilize local markets, including the forint, which recently touched a seven-month low against the euro amid a wider tech share downturn and a dovish central bank stance.

Karman emphasized that the favorable assessment reinforces economic security, lowers government bond yields and domestic lending rates, and supports a steadier forint exchange rate. Meanwhile, the Magyar Nemzeti Bank adopted a more cautious tone to protect the currency after previous rate-cut hints triggered a market slide. Despite recent declines, the forint remains the top-performing Central European currency this year, with S&P noting that its gains have helped counter commodity price swings.

S&P maintained the sovereign credit rating at "BBB-/A-3," bringing its stance in line with Moody's, which similarly lifted Hungary's outlook to stable last week while affirming its "Baa2" rating. S&P highlighted that Hungary's target to adopt the euro by 2032 could function as a vital policy anchor. However, the agency cautioned that the country's reliance on Russian energy remains a vulnerability, noting that regulated household energy subsidies cost roughly 1% of GDP and continue to pressure the national budget.

stories.title: Elon Musk Reports Google Seeks More Computing Capacity From SpaceX
stories.summary:
Elon Musk stated via a social media post on Saturday that Google has expressed interest in renting additional computing power from SpaceX, though he shared no further specifics. Representatives for Musk, SpaceX, and Google did not immediately respond to requests for comment from Reuters.

SpaceX already maintains a multi-year cloud services contract with Google that was established prior to SpaceX's major initial public offering. Under the terms of that agreement announced in June, Google is scheduled to pay SpaceX $920 million monthly starting from October of this year through June 2029. This provision encompasses roughly 110,000 Nvidia graphics processing units, central processing units, memory units, and related hardware.

Global demand for computational infrastructure has expanded dramatically since the introduction of generative artificial intelligence applications. This surge has driven technology enterprises to pour substantial capital into data centers outfitted with advanced processors from manufacturers like Nvidia. Earlier in May, rival firm Anthropic also announced an agreement to utilize SpaceX computational assets, and regulatory filings from June revealed that SpaceX held aggregate compute agreements with Google and Anthropic exceeding $70 billion.

To accommodate this growing demand, SpaceX is actively expanding its computational footprint beyond its primary hub in the Memphis area. Earlier this month, the company announced plans to invest more than $74 billion into a new supercomputing facility located at Starbase within the Rio Grande Valley in Texas, alongside a second campus situated in Cochise County, Arizona.

stories.title: Commerce Minister Directs Trade Officers to Secure Export Deals From FoodAg
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Commerce Jam Kamal Khan instructed Pakistan's Trade and Investment Officers to aggressively follow up with international buyers met during the fourth FoodAg Pakistan exhibition. The objective is to translate ongoing business discussions into formal export orders and long-term commercial partnerships.

The minister issued these directives during a post-exhibition review meeting held in Karachi on Saturday following the conclusion of the trade event. During the session, Jam Kamal evaluated progress reports, assessed the performance of trade officers, and gathered feedback regarding their interactions with visiting international buyers and commercial delegations. He praised the officials for successfully bringing foreign delegations to the country, connecting overseas purchasers with local suppliers, and raising Pakistan's trade profile abroad.

Jam Kamal advised organizers and officers to utilize insights gathered from both buyers and exhibitors to enhance business matchmaking and visitor support for future installments of the exhibition. He also proposed dedicating specific exhibition space to international corporations, arguing that their presence would grant domestic businesses greater opportunities to pursue joint ventures and technology alliances. Drawing from recent conversations with European, Chinese, and other foreign delegations, he emphasized investment prospects within farm machinery, food processing, storage, and warehousing sectors.

The minister stressed that adopting modern technology, increasing value addition, and adhering to international standards will empower Pakistani producers to broaden food exports and penetrate new global markets. He concluded by thanking the Trade Development Authority of Pakistan, Ministry of Commerce staff, and the event management team for their efforts in hosting the international delegations throughout the exhibition.

stories.title: India Struggles at 116-6 Following New Zealand's 356-Run Total
stories.summary:
India faces the prospect of concluding their New Zealand tour on a difficult note, stumbling to 116-6 by the close of the second day of the second Test at Hagley Oval in Christchurch. After New Zealand posted a first-innings total of 356 following an opening decision by Indian captain Shubman Gill to field, the visiting side collapsed under a series of loose shots against the home pace attack.

Rishabh Pant fell to Jacob Duffy for 23 after attempting a reckless stroke, while K.L. Rahul was dismissed for 25 after edging a loose drive. Washington Sundar became the final wicket of the day on the last ball, caught at second slip off Nathan Smith, leaving Dhruv Jurel unbeaten on seven at stumps. Duffy rebounded from a difficult outing in Wellington to claim 2-21 from eight overs, while Kyle Jamieson contributed 2-33 from 13 overs.

Earlier in the innings, New Zealand's bowlers dismantled the top order quickly. Matt Henry bowled Yashasvi Jaiswal for a duck in the opening over, and Jamieson subsequently removed Devdutt Padikkal for 21 and Shubman Gill before the end of the session. India's opening-day bowling strategy of bowling too short on a grassy pitch allowed New Zealand to build a solid foundation, featuring a fighting 89 from Tom Blundell and 59 from Tom Latham. Akash Deep was the pick of the Indian bowlers, claiming 5-99 from 31.3 overs.

Resuming the second day at 246-5, New Zealand added quickly through Blundell and Nathan Smith before being bowled out. India's spin bowling coach Sairaj Bahutule acknowledged that the team failed to hit optimal lengths consistently, particularly on day one, allowing New Zealand's bowlers to maintain better control and tighter lines. New Zealand currently holds third place in the World Test Championship standings, one position ahead of India.

stories.title: Zelenskiy Says Ukraine Sank Russian Ship in Libya Without European Coordination
stories.summary:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy announced that a recent military operation sinking a Russian warship at a Libyan naval base occurred without prior consultation with European allies. Zelenskiy confirmed this detail late Friday during a telephone conversation with Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni.

During their discussion, Meloni cautioned Kyiv against letting the ongoing conflict with Russia expand into the Mediterranean Sea. The war is currently in its fifth year following Moscow's full-scale invasion in February 2022. Zelenskiy emphasized the importance of mutual understanding and shared his commitment to maintaining direct and regular communication between respective authorities.

Earlier this month, Kyiv reported that its naval drones successfully targeted the Russian warship Merkury at a base in Benghazi. Ukrainian forces also struck a Russian cargo vessel off the Libyan coast, which officials claimed was utilized for transporting weapons. Authorities stressed that the military operation specifically targeted Moscow's assets rather than Libya itself.

The event matters as it highlights friction and communication gaps between Ukraine and its European partners regarding military actions outside Ukrainian borders. It also underscores the expanding geographic scope of the conflict into North Africa and the Mediterranean, raising strategic concerns for neighboring European nations like Italy.

stories.title: کوئٹہ گلیڈی ایٹرز نے فروخت سے متعلق خبروں پر وضاحت جاری کر دی
stories.summary:
پاکستان سپر لیگ کی فرنچائز کوئٹہ گلیڈی ایٹرز نے اپنی فروخت سے متعلق گردش کرنے والی افواہوں پر ردعمل ظاہر کرتے ہوئے ایک باضابطہ اعلامیہ جاری کیا ہے۔ فرنچائز کی جانب سے واضح کیا گیا ہے کہ مالکان ٹیم کو صرف اس صورت میں فروخت کرنے پر غور کریں گے جب کوئی ایسی غیر معمولی پیشکش موصول ہو جسے مسترد کرنا ناممکن ہو۔

حالیہ چند دنوں کے دوران سوشل میڈیا اور مختلف پوڈکاسٹس میں یہ چہ مہگوئیاں زور پکڑ رہی تھیں کہ کوئٹہ گلیڈی ایٹرز کے مالکان ٹیم فروخت کرنا چاہتے ہیں، جن میں مالک کی صحت کی خرابی اور ڈھائی سے تین ارب روپے کی مالیت کا تذکرہ بھی شامل تھا۔ اس تناظر میں فرنچائز کے ہیڈ آف پارٹنر شپ وارث عقیل نے واضح کیا کہ مالکان کسی جلدی میں نہیں ہیں اور پی ایس ایل کے ساتھ اپنے سفر کو جاری رکھنے کے لیے مکمل طور پر پرعزم ہیں۔

کوئٹہ گلیڈی ایٹرز سنہ 2015 میں دس سالہ معاہدے کے تحت سب سے کم بولی پر خریدی گئی تھی اور یہ ٹیم اب تک پانچ فائنلز کھیل چکی ہے جن میں سے دو بار فاتح رہی ہے۔ ٹیم نے آئندہ سیزن کے لیے نیوزی لینڈ کے تیز گیند باز لاکی فرگوسن کو سات کروڑ تریسٹھ لاکھ پاکستانی روپے میں براہ راست سائن بھی کر لیا ہے۔

فرنچائز کے عہدیداروں کا کہنا ہے کہ ندیم عمر کے بیان کا مقصد صرف یہ تھا کہ اب پی ایس ایل بہت بڑی ہو چکی ہے اور کھلاڑیوں کے لیے بڑے پیمانے پر سرمائے کی ضرورت ہوتی ہے۔ ٹیم انتظامیہ نے مالی مشکلات کے تاثر کو رد کرتے ہوئے اس بات کا اعادہ کیا ہے کہ موجودہ مالکان لیگ کے آئندہ ایڈیشنز کے لیے بھی پرجوش ہیں۔

stories.title: Rape Victim and Husband Shot Dead in Charsadda Attack
stories.summary:
An 18-year-old woman and her husband were shot and killed in Charsadda on Saturday while traveling in a rickshaw. The victims, identified as Laila Noor and her husband Haris Khan, were ambushed in the Ibrahimzai area under the jurisdiction of the Sardheri police station.

According to law enforcement, four assailants intercepted the couple, forced them out of the vehicle, and opened indiscriminate fire, resulting in immediate fatalities. The victims' remains were subsequently transported to Charsadda Hospital to complete necessary medico-legal procedures and post-mortem examinations. All four suspects fled the scene immediately following the shooting.

Police background details reveal that Laila Noor had previously been allegedly gang-raped at gunpoint by four men on September 11. Following that initial crime, authorities arrested three suspects while one remained at large. Two of the arrested individuals stayed in custody, whereas the third suspect, named Taimoor, was granted court bail.

Investigators state that Taimoor allegedly teamed up with three accomplices to execute the double murder of the survivor and her husband. Special police teams have now been deployed to track down and apprehend all four fleeing suspects involved in the weekend killings.

stories.title: Gold and Silver Prices Fall Across Pakistan Amid Global Market Decline
stories.summary:
Precious metal prices decreased across Pakistan on Saturday, tracking a downward correction in the international bullion market according to the All Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Association. Domestic gold rates for one tola dropped by Rs2,300 to reach Rs387,836, while the price for 10 grammes fell by Rs1,972 to Rs332,506.

Globally, gold fell by $23 per ounce down to $3,653. Concurrently, domestic silver prices decreased by Rs55, bringing the per tola rate to Rs4,851. Pakistan calculates its domestic gold prices using a pricing mechanism that adds a $20 per ounce premium over international market rates. Gold traditionally functions as a safe-haven asset, drawing investor interest during periods marked by inflation, geopolitical instability, and economic uncertainty.

The global correction follows pressure from a stronger US dollar and rising Treasury yields, which make dollar-denominated bullion more expensive for other currencies. Market analysts, such as Zain Vawda of Audacity Capital, note that recent price movements point to short-covering and profit-taking rather than fundamental trend shifts. Expectations of continued US Federal Reserve rate hikes could further cap near-term gains for precious metals.

This market movement matters to investors and local consumers who monitor precious metals closely for wealth preservation. Analysts continue to evaluate US monetary policy, currency fluctuations, and bond yields to forecast future price directions for gold and silver.

stories.title: Pakistan Telecommunication Authority Restores Submarine Cable and Internet Services
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Telecommunication Authority (PTA) announced on Saturday that the SEA-ME-WE 5 (SMW5) international submarine cable system has been fully restored. Internet services across the country have now returned to normal operating capacity following the successful repair of a technical fault.

The issue originated on November 18, when a disruption was detected in the SMW5 cable roughly 11 kilometres off Pakistan’s coast. Technical teams from Transworld Associates (TWA) and the international SMW5 consortium collaborated around the clock to rectify the damage. Throughout the outage, temporary rerouting of internet traffic through alternative international connections helped mitigate severe disruptions.

Submarine cables form the backbone of global telecommunications, facilitating data transfer across international borders and continents. Pakistan relies on seven distinct submarine cables for internet connectivity, managed collectively by PTCL, Transworld Associates, and Cyber Internet Services. A previous fault in this exact SMW5 system had similarly caused widespread connectivity problems earlier in July.

The resolution of this fault is critical for the country's digital infrastructure, businesses, and everyday users who depend on stable bandwidth. Maintaining robust connectivity prevents widespread slowdowns and ensures uninterrupted communication channels nationwide.

stories.title: Rawalpindi Police Officers Arrested for Accepting Bribe to Free Drug Suspects
stories.summary:
Six police officers in Rawalpindi, including an SHO and a sub-inspector, have been taken into custody following allegations that they accepted a bribe totaling Rs4 million to liberate members of an inter-district drug smuggling syndicate. The arrests stem from a formal case lodged at the Civil Lines police station, which was initiated on the instructions of Rawalpindi City Police Officer Dr. Sardar Ghayas Gul following the conclusions of an internal departmental investigation.

The implicated personnel consist of Saddar Wah police station SHO Sajjad Ahmed, Sub-Inspector Nabeel Ahmed, and four additional members of the police force. Law enforcement authorities are currently executing raids to apprehend any remaining suspects connected to the incident. According to the first information report, the officers originally detained two suspected drug traffickers named Bilal and Nazir, alongside two companions, holding them at an undisclosed private site for a duration of three days rather than logging a formal arrest.

Throughout the three-day detention period, Sub-Inspector Nabeel Ahmed allegedly reached out to the relatives of the captives using a mobile device to extort Rs4 million for their liberation. The payoff comprised Rs2 million paid in physical cash alongside an additional Rs2 million sent via digital transactions, both of which were uncovered during the probe. The documentation indicates that SHO Sajjad Ahmed personally collected Rs1 million from the illicit funds.

While both primary officers initially rejected the accusations throughout the departmental probe, investigators subsequently presented them with financial transaction logs and video surveillance provided by an intelligence entity. The visual evidence reportedly depicted Sub-Inspector Nabeel Ahmed and participating constables managing the detention of the targeted individuals.
